title: CHATCOM first-run setup (setup.json)
description: Answers to the 'Season premiere' setup, for runs without a terminal (skill mode, scripts, CI). Every field matches a flag of `chatcom new`; a flag wins over the file. Photos are recorded here and used by casting (Next Step 3).

title.description: Omit to let the writer name the show in episode 1.

operator_sender.description: Your own name as it appears in the chat.

timezone.description: IANA zone; default is this computer's zone.

cast.description: Who to cast. Omit to cast the 8 most active senders in episode 1's window.

photos.description: Member name to a reference photo path.

exclude.description: Members whose messages are removed before any model call; @mentions of them are replaced.

no_photo.description: Cast from texting behavior even if a photo is supplied.

no_cast.description: Keep out of the cast (they stay in the chorus).

aliases.description: Canonical name to the other display names (or phone numbers) the same person appears under.

looks.description: Member name (or nickname) to a short note on how they look, e.g. "beard, tall, glasses". Casting sends it with the image prompt (names removed) for that member's first drawing. No flag: edit the show's setup.json before `chatcom cast`.
